records.text: In 1964, a group of scientists including Peter Higgs theorized the Higgs boson.
records.speaker: Mark (Candace show producer; surname unverified)

appearances.snippet: And so in 1964, a group of scientists theorized that there's something called a Higgs boson, one of the scientists was named. and peter higgs i believe and so the search was on to find this particle

verification.notes: CERN states that Peter Higgs postulated the Higgs boson in 1964 alongside the independent work of Robert Brout and François Englert, matching the statement's description of a group of scientists including Higgs.

sources.title: CERN pays tribute to Peter Higgs
sources.relevance: Official CERN account confirms Higgs's 1964 postulate and the related work of Brout and Englert.

records.text: In 2012, CERN observed a reaction consistent with the Higgs boson theorized in 1964.
records.speaker: Mark (Candace show producer; surname unverified)

appearances.snippet: and peter higgs i believe and so the search was on to find this particle and so that's why cern created the large hadron collider which is based in geneva switzerland and is a 17 mile tunnel underground up to 600 feet underground in some places where they shoot particles at subatomic particles at each other at a very high speed to try and break them apart to see what they're found what they're composed of and so in 2012 they observed a reaction reaction that's consistent with this particle that was theorized back in 1964 that they were calling some people were calling it the god particle

verification.notes: CERN states that ATLAS and CMS reached the five-sigma discovery threshold on 4 July 2012 and identified a new particle consistent with the long-sought Higgs boson proposed decades earlier. 'Observed a reaction' is imprecise, but the factual substance is correct.

sources.title: How did we discover the Higgs boson? — CERN
sources.relevance: Official CERN explanation confirms the 2012 discovery of a particle consistent with the Higgs boson.
